app.tagline: Buy and sell cars, track every pound.

auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in to manage your showroom.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session has expired, please sign in again.

validation.paidExceedsPrice: Paid amount cannot exceed the price
validation.exceedsOwed: Cannot exceed the remaining owed amount ({{amount}})

messages.saveFailed: Could not save. Please try again.
messages.deleteFailed: Could not delete. Please try again.

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.subtitle: Everyone you buy cars from.
suppliers.deleteBody: This will permanently delete "{{name}}". Suppliers linked to buying bills cannot be deleted.
suppliers.emptyHint: Add your first supplier to start recording buying bills.

purchases.title: Buying Bills
purchases.subtitle: Cars bought from suppliers.
purchases.paidAmountHint: Fills in with the price automatically — lower it if you only paid part of it.
purchases.emptyHint: Record your first buying bill to start tracking stock.
purchases.cancelBody: This reverses its payments and returns the cars to available stock. Only possible while none of its cars have been sold.
purchases.cancelBlocked: This bill cannot be cancelled because at least one of its cars has already been sold.

sales.title: Selling Bills
sales.subtitle: Cars sold to buyers.
sales.noAvailableCars: No cars available to sell — every car in stock is already sold, or you have not recorded a buying bill yet.
sales.emptyHint: Sell a car from your stock to record your first selling bill.
sales.cancelBody: This reverses the sale, returns the car to stock, and deducts the selling price from capital.

stock.title: Stock
stock.subtitle: Cars bought but not sold yet.
stock.emptyHint: Cars you've bought but haven't sold yet will show up here.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.subtitle: Manual stock log by branch — separate from the rest of the app, doesn't affect accounts.
inventory.deleteBranchBody: This will permanently delete "{{name}}". Branches with cars logged against them cannot be deleted.
inventory.branchDeleteFailed: Could not delete this branch — it may still have cars logged against it.
inventory.paidAmountHint: Fills in with the full customer price automatically — lower it if the buyer only paid part of it.
inventory.deleteItemBody: This will permanently delete "{{name}}" from the inventory log.
inventory.emptyHint: Add a car to start tracking stock at your branches.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.subtitle: Capital, supplier debt, profit and expenses.
accounts.totalMoneyHint: Everything you've added as capital, plus profit or loss from every car you've sold, minus expenses.
accounts.moneyTiedUpHint: {{amount}} of this is tied up in {{count}} unsold car(s) — not liquid cash yet.
accounts.negativeCapitalHint: Negative capital means you owe suppliers more than you have on hand.
accounts.whoIOweHint: Suppliers still owed money for cars already recorded as bought.
accounts.profitHint: Total profit (selling price minus buying price) for the selected period.
accounts.emptyOwed: You don't owe any supplier money right now.
accounts.emptyExpenses: No expenses recorded for this period.
accounts.emptyExpensesHint: Add an expense to track money spent outside of buying cars.

summary.title: Summary
summary.subtitle: Every buying, selling, payment and expense movement.

errors.pageBody: The page you are looking for does not exist.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: System branding, database backups and restore.
settings.logoTooLarge: That image is too large (max 5 MB).
settings.backupsHint: Every backup — manual and automatic — is saved in backend/backups.
settings.resetHint: Permanently deletes every supplier, buying bill, selling bill and expense. Your login and these settings are kept.
settings.resetBody: This permanently deletes every supplier, buying bill, selling bill and expense. Your login and these settings are kept. A safety backup of the current database is taken automatically first.
settings.resetSafetyNote: A safety backup is saved to backend/backups before anything is deleted, so this can be undone by restoring it.
settings.restoreFromFileHint: Replace the live database with a .db backup file from your computer.
settings.restoreBody: This replaces everything in the live database with the contents of the file you pick. A safety backup of the current database is taken automatically first.
settings.restoreSafetyNote: A safety backup of the current database is saved to backend/backups before the swap, so this can be undone by restoring it.
settings.restoreDropHint: Click or drag a .db backup file here
settings.restoreFileHint: Only .db files created by this system are accepted.
settings.restoreThisBody: This replaces everything in the live database with the contents of "{{filename}}".
settings.safetyBackupSaved: The previous database was saved as {{filename}} in backend/backups.
